finding.text: `AIPage.js:21` `holder()` only says "dock" when the AI tab is already open while the page mounts, and `resized` (AIPage.js:55) listens to the 52em media query only. At 1200 on `<path>/ai/`, the page mounts the chat. If you then press ✦ and open the dock's AI tab, `tabs/ai.js` mounts a second chat and feed, which is the same double mount the task was to remove. Nothing re-runs `fill` when the tab opens.

Page and dock share the module-level `live_chat`/`live_feed` in `tabs/ai.js:226`, and `release()` (AIPage.js:48) calls `dispose_chat`. If the dock mounts after the page does (finding 1), the page's release on deactivate or resize disposes the dock's chat, not the page's.

The diff edits `tabs/ai.js` and `doc/sheet.md`, which are outside the stated fence (`Sheet.js`, `AIPage.js`, `AIFeed`, one readme line). The `tabs/ai.js` change is needed for the feed lifetime, so it is defensible, but the log should say so. The readme change is also longer than "one line" (it is a bullet, but the long Sheet paragraph was left untouched, which is fine).

The approach is "only one surface mounts, the others show a pointer", not "share one instance". That meets "no second instance is ever created" and is simpler. No `decision` line comparing it to the adopt-the-sheet's-instance option is visible in the diff, so check `task.jsonl` for it.

`SheetPanel.release()` (Sheet.js:~99) calls `this.$live.el.querySelectorAll` and `this.$slot.empty()` without guarding for a panel whose `$live` or `$slot` was never built, for example `release` called before first show. Use `?.`.

The 1/1 counts in strip, split, full and dock, the fake-mic two-sentence proof and the `check_page` runs are not in the diff; they rest on `probe.mjs` and the `finish` line. I could not check them from the patch, so confirm `tail -1 task.jsonl` shows the counts and that dock-after-page was among the cases (see finding 1).

The diff touches `ext/drawer/rail/shots/files.jsonl` and `ext/drawer/walkthrough/shots/files.jsonl` (outside the fence), appending `"gone":true` lines for files that are still listed above them; harmless but unrelated noise, and the requirement said shots are never committed.

`after.txt` shows the counts at strip, split, full, 1200 page and 1920 dock all at 1 widget and 1 feed, and the fake mic check says "3 sentences" where the ask said two (after.txt:21-24); each appears once, so it meets the intent.

The fix adds a fair amount of coordination (`holder()`, `moved`, `shut`, `resized`, a `drawer-chat` event, `release_chat`) in `AIPage.js:22-107`; a single owner of the chat that the sheet, page and dock all ask would be simpler, but the alternative is recorded in task.jsonl (4 `decision` lines) and the behaviour is proven.

`AIPage.js:47` calls `m.default(...)` with `this.mounting` as the only guard against the dock's own `drawer-chat` event; a throw inside `ai()` is covered by `finally`, so this is fine, just worth knowing if the event gains other listeners.
